subject: When should an OT move beyond a static mattress?
preheader: Craig Gorman will compare static, hybrid and powered support surfaces in Brighton East on 21 October.
intro: Static, hybrid and powered mattresses can all be the right answer. The clinical work is knowing what changes the decision.
On 21 October, Craig Gorman from Forté Healthcare will lead a practical, in-person session for occupational therapists at Sleep Choice in Brighton East.
body: Craig will work through how risk, mobility, transfers, positioning, microclimate, comfort, carer involvement and the home environment shape mattress selection. You will compare how different support surfaces work, where they fit and what to look for when the prescription moves into the home.
You will also see how Sleep Choice can arrange flexible in-home trials across the Forté range, so a proposed mattress can be assessed with the actual bed, routines and support setup.
If mattress or bed prescription is part of your caseload, this is two hours designed to be useful the next time you need to make the call.
detail: In-person OT training · Forté lists 2 CPD points · Lunch provided
